title: Accessibility: Semantic HTML
description:
Part of larger accessibility ticket #148. Ensure proper semantic HTML structure throughout the application.

**Requirements:**
- Use proper heading hierarchy (h1, h2, h3 in order)
- Use <nav> for navigation sections
- Use <main> for primary content
- Use <section> for logical sections
- Use <article> for self-contained content
- Use <aside> for sidebar content
- Use <footer> for footer content
- Use <button> for buttons, not <div> with click handler
- Use <a> for links, not <div> with navigation

**Implementation Steps:**
1. Audit all pages for heading hierarchy issues
2. Replace <div> buttons with <button> elements
3. Replace <div> links with <a> elements
4. Add semantic sectioning elements where missing
5. Ensure navigation uses <nav>
6. Ensure main content uses <main>
7. Test with screen reader

**Files:**
- All page-level Vue components
- Navigation components
- Components with click handlers

**Estimated Effort:** 2-3 hours
**Priority:** Medium
**Dependencies:** None

**Note**: This is sub-task 3 of ticket #148 (Accessibility - 12-16 hours total)
